Website information

Privacy.

This is a static website about P.J. Ray and Living with Bipolar.

Browsing this site

The website code does not set cookies, use analytics, or store information in your browser. Fonts and images are served with the website. The hosting provider may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to deliver the site.

Getting in touch

Email links open your own email application. This site does not submit or store messages through a contact form. Messages you choose to send are processed by the email services involved. Please do not send sensitive medical information.

The optional Copy address button writes the displayed email address to your clipboard only when you select it.

External links

Links to Amazon take you to another service, whose privacy practices and terms apply. See GitHub’s privacy statement (opens in a new tab) for information about the configured hosting provider.

Questions

For questions about this website, email hello@pjraybooks.com.
